text_block_list.text:
Уиннинг Тикит's burning resolve to win
ends in
her claiming victory at the Arima
Kinen.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After the race, she tells her precious
friends that
she hopes to have many
more passion-filled races
together.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The two rivals accept, asserting that
they don't
intend to lose. Winning
Ticket is overjoyed at the
idea of racing
with them again.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Then, she notices the increasing cheers
of
"Tickezo" coming from the stands.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Shouting words of gratitude, she smiles
with a
light that brightens the entire
track.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
